answer: Votes pay out in arrears. Each key plants a lotus — one claim per key — and the vault it opens on the roll accrues 8 POA of share each epoch, vesting only after audit. Each epoch the roll sounds its echo; the key signs that echo within 120 seconds. Lottery auditors replay one vault in seven; a missed echo, or one echo heard in two vaults, confiscates the unvested share to the audit fund and benches the key. Fakes cannot pool: N fakes × 8 POA = 8N POA forfeited per epoch. Limit: everyone vests on the same clock.
